architecture: All business data remains exclusively local in the active dashboard. SQL services are isolated until the complete related business model and services pass migration and equivalence tests. The earlier hybrid/journal proposal is not activated.
scope: Foundational catalogs, project metadata and customers only. No sales, subscriptions, balances, product data or original JSON backup is imported in this block.

api.gate: CENTRO_BUSINESS_API_ENABLED=0 by default. Explicit opt-in also requires local environment, 127.0.0.1 SQL host, mysql auth driver and an active administrator session. Enabled only by isolated test processes.

read.limit: 500 rows; larger results fail explicitly with listing_limit. Paginated export is pending.

response.failure: ok=false, code=controlled_code; no SQL text or credentials

api.internal_dto: Snake-case normalized SQL DTO, separate from the legacy state. No frontend adapter or equivalence claim yet. Currencies use their code as ID; settings use the singleton ID main.
api.validation: Resource/field allowlists; IDs, UTF-8 and text lengths; dates; HTTP(S) URLs; email; enums; colors; decimal strings; active references in the same environment. Full domain validation for financial operations is pending.

transaction_contract.permissions: Single active administrator id=1; business clients are not auth users. All environments belong to this personal installation.
transaction_contract.atomicity: One PDO transaction contains every change, the idempotent result receipt and the audit row. Callback failure or validation/integrity failure rolls back everything.
transaction_contract.concurrency: Lock the environment row first. Per-record expected_version must match; create expects version 0. Conflicts return 409. Per-environment serialization is intentional for personal use, not a high-throughput multi-tenant design.
transaction_contract.idempotency: Operation IDs are stable client-provided 16-100 character tokens. Canonical payload hash and actor must match on retry; reuse with a different payload returns 409. Successful retries return the original result without another write or audit entry.
transaction_contract.references: Composite foreign keys include environment_id; ON DELETE RESTRICT. Archive preserves ID and row, increments version, hides it from active reads. Active children prevent parent archive. A financial reference policy must be added with the financial modules.
transaction_contract.money: DECIMAL(20,2) investment, DECIMAL(9,6) commission. Monetary inputs are nonnegative decimal strings; exponent notation and float inputs are rejected, not silently rounded. Future arithmetic must remain exact.
transaction_contract.audit: Append-only application permissions. JSON columns hold only command audit or operation result, not the business state. Individual entities are typed relational rows.

complete_model_and_dependencies.existing_full_design: preparation/schema-design.json remains the conceptual model for all entities; unimplemented tables in that file are proposals, not created tables.
complete_model_and_dependencies.ordering: Complete catalog and dataset-scope contracts before dependent financial tables. Then implement coherent command groups with receipts and audit: product+versions+links; sale+customer+receipt; subscription+price snapshot+sale+event+receipt; expense+allocations+payment; transfer+both account amounts; import event+dedup record+all effects.
invariants: A receipt cannot be recreated by restoring a sale
A retry cannot duplicate any side effect
Historical subscription prices do not change when current plans change
Never total unmatched currencies as if converted
Expense allocation preserves the global total
Transfers preserve both currencies and explicit amounts
A failed integration event leaves no customer, sale or subscription partial changes
complete_model_and_dependencies.financial_policy_pending: Characterize original refund/void/paid-expense behavior before implementing SQL finance; do not silently change historical totals or turn commercial refunds into inferred cash movements.

future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.activation_gate: Not available in the SQL API until all business modules, complete JSON validation and end-to-end tests are implemented. Existing browser buttons are unchanged.
future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.scope: A future SQL restore/wipe applies to one complete business environment shared by all sessions, never a partial browser-local subset. Authentication, credentials and other environments are excluded.
future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.backup: Consistent complete SQL snapshot plus manifest with schema version, environment/dataset revision, counts and checksums; exclude passwords, sessions and local PIN. This is distinct from the private synthetic pre-migration SQL dump used by this block.
future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.preview: Validate all collections, types, enum values, IDs, duplicate normalized keys, relationships, money, dates and unsupported fields before writes. Report differences, conflicts, missing exchange rates and historical unknowns; do not invent history or silently discard fields.
future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.restore: Require preview bound to backup checksum and expected dataset revision, explicit confirmation and stable operation ID. Save a private destination backup first. Stage a complete replacement dataset, verify counts/amounts/balances/references, then atomically switch the active dataset pointer. Retain the prior dataset read-only for recovery; never replay createSale to reconstruct old receipts.
future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.wipe: Require explicit environment confirmation and expected dataset revision, private prior backup and stable operation ID. Atomically switch to a new empty dataset for that environment, retaining the old dataset read-only. Other environments and authentication remain unchanged.
future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.prerequisite_migration: Dataset generations and active-dataset pointers, including generation scope in entity FKs and command receipts, must be added and tested before restore/wipe or financial activation. This first-block schema has only environment scope and cannot yet implement these operations safely.
future_backup_restore_wipe_contract.browser: No automatic deletion or import. Legacy backups require explicit staged migration; server preview conflicts must be resolved before activation. Existing browser data remains available until a separately reviewed complete cutover.

migration_contract.guards: CLI, local 127.0.0.1 isolated centro_auth_ schema, verified 001 checksum, existing private destination backup under .runtime, exact auth-only baseline or already-applied matching 002 checksum. Backup sidecar manifest must match destination database and actual dump SHA-256.
migration_contract.ddl_limit: MySQL/MariaDB DDL is not transactionally rolled back. Partial or unexpected schema is refused on retry and requires manual recovery from the preserved backup. No automatic deletion. Only MariaDB 11.4.13 has been exercised; Hostinger/MySQL compatibility is not claimed as tested.

next_block: Add dataset generations, remaining catalogs and product/version/package services, with exact-ID synthetic backup validation. Continue isolated; financial workflows, whole-state restore/wipe and dashboard cutover remain later blocks.
